tools.name: recent_decisions
tools.title: Recent decisions
tools.description: List the most recent Sentinel Gateway safety decisions (allow, deny, human-review) with risk score, gate, reason and hash.

decision.description: Optional decision filter, e.g. ALLOWED, DENIED, REQUIRE_HITL.

tools.name: fleet_status
tools.title: Fleet status
tools.description: Report the status of every AI agent in the Sentinel Gateway fleet: active or quarantined, request volume, blocked count and average risk.

tools.name: evaluate_policy
tools.title: Evaluate policy
tools.description: Run a proposed agent action through the Sentinel Gateway policy engine and return the decision, matched rule and reason.

action_type.description: Action type, e.g. issue_refund or transfer_funds.

amount.description: Dollar amount involved in the action.

reason.description: Business justification supplied by the agent.

tools.name: list_policies
tools.title: List policies
tools.description: List the Sentinel Gateway policy documents with their live version number and the rules currently in production.

tools.name: verify_audit_chain
tools.title: Verify audit chain
tools.description: Verify the cryptographic hash chain of the Sentinel Gateway audit ledger and report whether it is intact.

tools.name: compliance_report
tools.title: Compliance report
tools.description: Generate a regulator-ready Sentinel Gateway compliance summary: decision totals, spend evaluated and audit chain integrity.

include_log.description: Include the most recent 20 ledger entries in the response.
